On Thu, May 28, 2026 at 3:10 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> (thread recap)

Hi Jamal looping in pricing/solutions details. Below is a preliminary unit-economics sketch using the model mix you confirmed. These are list/starting prices for a Hosted + Dedicated blended proposal; final numbers will depend on a committed capacity term.

Per-model reference pricing (list, per 1M input+output tokens):
- redwood-chat-1 (chat gen): $110 / 1M tokens
- redwood-embed-1 (embeddings): $35 / 1M tokens
- redwood-rerank-1 (reranker): $75 / 1M tokens

Using your pilot mix (20M total / month):
- chat (65% = 13M tokens) -> 13 * $110 = $1,430
- embeddings (25% = 5M tokens) -> 5 * $35 = $175
- rerank (10% = 2M tokens) -> 2 * $75 = $150
Estimated pilot monthly cost (list prices): $1,755 -> implied blended rate = $87.75 / 1M tokens

For steady-state (150M/month) same mix gives blended list rate $87.75 / 1M -> monthly = $13,162.50 (list).

Commitment options we typically see:
- 3-mo pilot commitment: list price (no discount) or small pilot credits to evaluate.
- 12-mo reserved capacity (committed tokens): up to 30% off list depending on volume and term; example: 150M/month committed -> ~20 630% discount band.

Next steps from our side:
1) If your target blended band is $120 60 $150 / 1M, our current list blended ($87.75) is already below that; are you targeting $120 60 $150 as an acceptable price floor or is that the maximum you want to pay (i.e., looking for something cheaper)? Please clarify.
2) We'll prepare a committed-capacity pricing sheet (3 tier examples) and a short MSA/term summary for procurement.
3) If helpful, we can provide a 30-min technical review with Connor to validate inference latencies/throughput for your workload.

Happy to hop on a quick call Marissa, can you propose times?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
